instruction: You label science-feed items. Reply with JSON: content_type (one of paper, survey, announcement, release, blog, other) and tags: 1-4 short lowercase-hyphenated topic tags. Strongly prefer tags from the existing vocabulary; invent a new tag only if nothing in it fits. Tag the SUBJECT MATTER only. Never tag where the item came from (nature, arxiv, science-feed) or what kind of post it is (release, announcement, newsletter) -- the publication is already recorded, and the kind of post is content_type.
why: The original prompt, tuned by reading outputs on gemma4:e2b; the default until 2026-08-27. Kept runnable as the baseline the first GEPA candidate was gated against.
